title: Why Charizard Looks Tiny Beside Itself
premise: Gigantamax Charizard grows from 1.7 meters to 28 meters, over sixteen times its normal height.
audiencePromise: Watch normal Charizard become a giant so large it makes itself look tiny.
openLoop: What makes Charizard look tiny beside its own form?
payoff: At 28 meters, Gigantamax Charizard towers over a stack of sixteen normal Charizards.
engagementQuestion: Which feels like Charizard: 1.7-meter flier or 28-meter giant?

voice.instructions: Use a hushed, incredulous tone at first. Build through the weight and height reveals, then land the final question with playful conviction.

scenes.headline: CHARIZARD LOOKS TINY?
scenes.narration: Charizard looks tiny beside its own form.
scenes.caption: ONE CHARIZARD DWARFS ANOTHER

scenes.headline: ONLY 1.7 METERS TALL
scenes.narration: The Flame Pokémon is only one point seven meters tall.
scenes.caption: CHARIZARD HEIGHT: 1.7 M

scenes.headline: A FULL 1,000 KILOGRAMS
scenes.narration: Its Gigantamax form weighs a full one thousand kilograms.
scenes.caption: GMAX WEIGHT: 1,000 KG

scenes.headline: 28 METERS TALL
scenes.narration: Gigantamax Charizard stands twenty-eight meters tall, not one point seven.
scenes.caption: 1.7 M → 28 M

scenes.headline: SIXTEEN CHARIZARDS HIGH
scenes.narration: More than sixteen normal Charizards reach from ground to its head.
scenes.caption: STACK NORMAL CHARIZARDS TO ITS HEAD

scenes.headline: WHICH FEELS REAL?
scenes.narration: Which feels like Charizard: 1.7-meter flier or 28-meter giant?
scenes.caption: NORMAL CHARIZARD OR GIGANTAMAX?
